# Kinu – Comprehensive LLM Reference

> This is the exhaustive reference for Kinu, a performance-focused Preact UI component library.
> For a concise quick-reference, see llms.txt.

## Architecture & Philosophy

Kinu is a constraint-driven collection of Preact components that enhance native HTML instead of
replacing it. Every component forwards props to the underlying HTML element, keeping semantics,
accessibility, and native performance. CSS drives state, variants, and animation; JavaScript only
wires up what the platform cannot express on its own.

### Core Principles

- **Platform first** — Components wrap native elements (`<button>`, `<dialog>`, `<details>`, `<input>`)
- **CSS as logic** — Props map to attributes; selectors read them. No runtime prop filtering.
- **Tiny runtime** — ~1.2 KB JS + ~6 KB CSS. No router, store, or theme engine.
- **Composable primitives** — Complex widgets stitch together smaller building blocks.
- **Tree-shakeable** — Import only what you need from the `kinu` package.

### How Components Render

`<Button variant="secondary" />` outputs `<button k="button" variant="secondary" />`.
The `k` attribute is the CSS hook. All other props pass through to the native element.
TypeScript knows the exact HTML attributes available for each component.

## Installation & Setup

```bash
pnpm add kinu    # or: npm install kinu
```

Peer dependency: `preact@^10.26.8`

```ts
// 1. Import stylesheet once at app entry:
import 'kinu/style.css';

// 2. Import components as needed:
import { Button, Card, Input, Dialog } from 'kinu';

// 3. Types are also exported:
import type { ButtonProps, ButtonVariant } from 'kinu';
```

Package exports:
- `kinu` → `dist/index.js` (ES module) + `dist/index.d.ts` (types)
- `kinu/style.css` → `dist/index.css` (all component styles)

## Component Factory Pattern

Most components are created via `createSimpleComponent(name, tag, defaultProps?, refCallback?)`:

```ts
// This sets k="card" on a <div> and merges defaultProps
const Card = createSimpleComponent('card', 'div');
const Input = createSimpleComponent('input', 'input', { type: 'text' });
```

The factory:
1. Sets `k={name}` on the rendered element for CSS targeting
2. Resolves the HTML tag (static string or dynamic function)
3. Merges default props via prototype chain (zero allocation)
4. Forwards refs with optional cleanup callbacks
5. Sets `displayName` for devtools

## Shared Types (BaseProps)

```typescript
interface BaseProps {
  command?: 'show-modal' | 'close' | 'show-popover' | 'hide-popover' | 'toggle-popover' | `--${string}` | null;
  commandFor?: string | null;
  children?: ComponentChildren;
}

interface RequiredChildrenProps extends BaseProps {
  children: ComponentChildren;
}
```

Component prop types follow the pattern:
- `FooOwnProps` — custom kinu props (variant, size, etc.)
- `FooProps` = `FooOwnProps & Omit<JSX.IntrinsicElements[tag], keyof FooOwnProps>`
- This means every native HTML attribute for the base element is supported.

## Design Tokens

All tokens use the `--k-` prefix. Color values are space-separated HSL triplets
used as `hsl(var(--k-primary))`.

### Light Theme Defaults

| Token | Default Value | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--k-background` | `0 0% 100%` | Page background |
| `--k-foreground` | `222.2 84% 4.9%` | Default text color |
| `--k-card` | `0 0% 100%` | Card surface |
| `--k-card-foreground` | `222.2 84% 4.9%` | Card text |
| `--k-popover` | `0 0% 100%` | Popover/dialog surface |
| `--k-popover-foreground` | `222.2 84% 4.9%` | Popover text |
| `--k-sidebar` | `0 0% 98%` | Sidebar surface |
| `--k-primary` | `222.2 47.4% 11.2%` | Primary action color |
| `--k-primary-foreground` | `210 40% 98%` | Text on primary |
| `--k-primary-hover` | `222.2 47.4% 8.2%` | Primary hover state |
| `--k-secondary` | `210 40% 96%` | Secondary action color |
| `--k-secondary-foreground` | `222.2 84% 4.9%` | Text on secondary |
| `--k-secondary-hover` | `210 40% 92%` | Secondary hover state |
| `--k-muted` | `210 40% 96%` | Muted backgrounds |
| `--k-muted-foreground` | `215.4 16.3% 46.9%` | Muted text |
| `--k-accent` | `210 40% 95%` | Accent highlights |
| `--k-accent-foreground` | `222.2 84% 4.9%` | Text on accent |
| `--k-destructive` | `0 84.2% 60.2%` | Destructive action color |
| `--k-destructive-foreground` | `210 40% 98%` | Text on destructive |
| `--k-destructive-hover` | `0 84.2% 50.2%` | Destructive hover state |
| `--k-border` | `214.3 31.8% 91.4%` | Default border color |
| `--k-input` | `214.3 31.8% 91.4%` | Input border color |
| `--k-ring` | `222.2 84% 4.9%` | Focus ring color |
| `--k-radius` | `0.5rem` | Default border radius |
| `--k-ease-fallback` | `cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)` | Fallback easing curve |
| `--k-ease-out` | `var(--k-ease-fallback)` | Standard ease-out curve |
| `--k-ease-elastic` | `var(--k-ease-fallback)` | Elastic animation curve |
| `--k-ease-spring` | `var(--k-ease-fallback)` | Spring animation curve |
| `--k-ease-out` | `linear(
    0,
    0.012 0.9%,
    0.049 2%,
  ...` | Standard ease-out curve |
| `--k-ease-out` | `linear(
    0,
    0.402 7.4%,
    0.711 15.3%,...` | Standard ease-out curve |
| `--k-ease-elastic` | `linear(
    0,
    0.007 1.2%,
    0.027 2.5%,
...` | Elastic animation curve |
| `--k-ease-spring` | `linear(
    0,
    -0.012 8.8%,
    -0.081 25.4...` | Spring animation curve |
| `--k-ease` | `var(--k-ease-out)` | Main animation easing (alias) |

### Dark Mode Tokens

Applied via `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` or `.dark` class:

```css
[data-theme="dark"], .dark {
  --k-background: 222.2 50% 7%;
  --k-foreground: 210 40% 98%;
  --k-primary: 210 40% 98%;
  --k-primary-foreground: 222.2 47.4% 11.2%;
  /* ... all tokens have dark variants */
}
```

## Theming & Dark Mode

Override tokens at root or within a scope:

```css
:root {
  --k-radius: 0.625rem;
  --k-primary: 221 83% 53%;
}

[data-theme="dark"] {
  --k-background: 224 71% 4%;
}
```

Toggle dark mode in JS:

```ts
document.documentElement.dataset.theme = 'dark';
document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark');
```

Custom component variants via CSS:

```css
[k="button"][variant="brand"] {
  background-color: hsl(var(--brand));
}
```

## Command Attributes

Kinu uses a lightweight polyfill for the HTML Command API to declaratively control dialogs:

```tsx
<button command="show-modal" commandFor="my-dialog">Open</button>
<dialog id="my-dialog">Content</dialog>
```

### Available Commands

| Command | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `show-modal` | Calls `showModal()` on target dialog |
| `show` | Calls `show()` on target dialog (non-modal) |
| `close` | Closes the target dialog |
| `show-popover` | Shows a popover |
| `hide-popover` | Hides a popover |
| `toggle-popover` | Toggles a popover |
| `--custom` | Fires a CustomEvent on the target |

The polyfill auto-installs when any dialog/dropdown/sheet component renders.
Commands dispatch as CustomEvents (`kinu-command`) for interception.

## Typography

Typography is CSS-only — use native HTML elements with `k` attributes:

```html
<h1 k="h1">Page title</h1>
<p k="lead">Intro paragraph</p>
<p k="muted">Secondary text</p>
<p k="small">Fine print</p>
```

Available typography attributes: `k="h1"` through `k="h4"`, `k="lead"`, `k="muted"`, `k="small"`.

## Base Styles

`kinu/style.css` includes:
- Modern CSS reset (box-sizing, typography smoothing, dialog/backdrop defaults)
- Design tokens for light/dark themes as `--k-*` custom properties
- All component selectors keyed off the `k` attribute

Import once before custom overrides:

```ts
import 'kinu/style.css';
```

## Component Reference

### Actions

#### Button

Button component that forwards props to `<button>` or `<a>` when href is provided.

**Source:** `src/components/button/index.tsx`

**Exports:**

| Export | Renders As | k Attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Button` | `(composite)` | `k="button"` |

**Props:**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `ButtonVariant` | 'default' | Visual style variant. |
| `size` | `ButtonSize` | 'md' | Size preset for the button. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | — | Shows a pending state and disables interactions. |
| `href` | `string` | — | When provided, renders the Button as an anchor element. |
| `target` | `string | undefined | null` | — | Target for anchor elements. |
| `rel` | `string | undefined | null` | — | Relationship between the current page and the linked resource. |
| `onClick` | `(event: MouseEvent) => void | null` | — | Click handler for the button. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | — | Disables interactions and applies disabled styling. |
| `type` | `string | undefined | null` | — | Button type attribute. |

**Usage:**

```tsx
import {Button} from 'kinu';

<Button variant="outline">Action</Button>
```

**Notes:**
- Use the loading attribute to reflect pending state without extra handlers.
- Supports size attributes (sm, md, lg, icon) controlled purely with CSS.

---

#### Dialog

Composable modal built on the native `<dialog>` element.

**Source:** `src/components/dialog/index.tsx`

**Exports:**

| Export | Renders As | k Attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Dialog` | `(composite)` | `—` |
| `DialogTrigger` | `(composite)` | `—` |
| `DialogContent` | `(composite)` | `—` |
| `DialogClose` | `(composite)` | `—` |

**Compound access:**
- `Dialog.Trigger` = `DialogTrigger`
- `Dialog.Content` = `DialogContent`
- `Dialog.Close` = `DialogClose`

**Props:**

*DialogOwnProps:*

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | — | Optional ID for the dialog. If not provided, one will be auto-generated. |

*DialogContentOwnProps:*

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | — | Override the auto-generated dialog ID. |

**Usage:**

```tsx
import {Dialog, DialogClose, DialogContent, DialogTrigger} from 'kinu';

<Dialog>
  <DialogTrigger><Button>Open</Button></DialogTrigger>
  <DialogContent>Modal body</DialogContent>
  <DialogClose><Button>Close</Button></DialogClose>
</Dialog>
```

**Notes:**
- Relies on command attributes instead of portal gymnastics.
- Dialog.Content forwards all native `<dialog>` props.

---

#### Alert Dialog

Alias of Dialog with alert-focused styling defaults.

**Source:** `src/components/alert-dialog/index.tsx`

**Exports:**

| Export | Renders As | k Attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `AlertDialog` | `(composite)` | `—` |

**Props:**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | — | Optional ID for the dialog. If not provided, one will be auto-generated. |

**Usage:**

```tsx
import {AlertDialog} from 'kinu';

<AlertDialog>
  <AlertDialog.Trigger>Delete</AlertDialog.Trigger>
  <AlertDialog.Content>Confirm action</AlertDialog.Content>
</AlertDialog>
```

**Notes:**
- Re-exports Dialog so you get Trigger, Content, Close, and other helpers.
- Use when you want dialog markup that communicates a destructive decision.

#### Drawer

Bottom sheet style overlay with trigger and close helpers.

**Source:** `src/components/drawer/index.tsx`

**Exports:**

| Export | Renders As | k Attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Drawer` | `(composite)` | `—` |
| `DrawerTrigger` | `(composite)` | `—` |
| `DrawerContent` | `(composite)` | `—` |
| `DrawerClose` | `(composite)` | `—` |

**Compound access:**
- `Drawer.Trigger` = `DrawerTrigger`
- `Drawer.Content` = `DrawerContent`
- `Drawer.Close` = `DrawerClose`

**Props:**

*DrawerOwnProps:*

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | — | Optional ID for the drawer dialog. If not provided, one will be auto-generated. |

*DrawerContentOwnProps:*

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | — | Override the auto-generated dialog ID. |

**Usage:**

```tsx
import {Drawer, DrawerClose, DrawerContent, DrawerTrigger} from 'kinu';

<Drawer>
  <DrawerTrigger><Button>Open</Button></DrawerTrigger>
  <DrawerContent>Content</DrawerContent>
  <DrawerClose><Button>Close</Button></DrawerClose>
</Drawer>
```

**Notes:**
- Positions content with CSS variables so you can change direction.
- Attach Drawer.Close to any element that should dismiss.

#### Dropdown Menu

Command-driven dropdown built on top of `<dialog>`.

**Source:** `src/components/dropdown-menu/index.tsx`

**Exports:**

| Export | Renders As | k Attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DropdownMenu` | `(composite)` | `—` |
| `DropdownMenuTrigger` | `(composite)` | `—` |
| `DropdownMenuContent` | `(composite)` | `—` |
| `DropdownMenuItem` | `(composite)` | `k="dropdown-menu-item"` |

**Props:**

*DropdownMenuOwnProps:*

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | — | Optional ID for the dropdown content. If not provided, one will be auto-generated. |

*DropdownMenuContentOwnProps:*

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | — | Override the auto-generated dialog ID. |
| `command` | `string` | 'close' | Command dispatched when the dialog receives the command event. |
| `commandFor` | `string` | — | Target dialog identifier for the command dispatch. |
| `to` | `"left"` | — | Align the menu panel to the trigger's left or right edge. |

*DropdownMenuItemOwnProps:*

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `href` | `string` | — | When provided, renders the item as an anchor element. |
| `selected` | `boolean` | — | Marks the item as selected for styling. |
| `shortcut` | `string` | — | Optional shortcut hint rendered on the trailing edge. |
| `destructive` | `boolean` | — | Applies destructive styling to the item. |

**Usage:**

```tsx
import {DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuTrigger} from 'kinu';

<DropdownMenu>
  <DropdownMenuTrigger><Button>Open</Button></DropdownMenuTrigger>
  <DropdownMenuContent>
    <DropdownMenuItem>Item</DropdownMenuItem>
  </DropdownMenuContent>
</DropdownMenu>
```

**Notes:**
- Menu items render as `<button>` elements by default.
- Automatically closes when an item dispatches the close command.

#### Context Menu

Right-click context menu powered by the native dialog element.

**Source:** `src/components/context-menu/index.tsx`

**Exports:**

| Export | Renders As | k Attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ContextMenuTrigger` | `(composite)` | `—` |
| `ContextMenu` | `(composite)` | `—` |
| `ContextMenuContent` | `(composite)` | `—` |
| `ContextMenuItem` | `<button>` | `k="context-menu-item"` |

**Props:**

*ContextMenuOwnProps:*

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | — | Optional ID for the context menu dialog. If not provided, one will be auto-generated. |

*ContextMenuContentOwnProps:*

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | — | Override the auto-generated dialog ID. |

*ContextMenuItemOwnProps:*

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selected` | `boolean` | — | Marks the item as selected for styling. |
| `shortcut` | `string` | — | Optional shortcut hint rendered on the trailing edge. |
| `destructive` | `boolean` | — | Applies destructive styling to the item. |

*Also accepts all native `<button>` HTML attributes.*

**Usage:**

```tsx
import {ContextMenu, ContextMenuContent, ContextMenuItem, ContextMenuTrigger} from 'kinu';

<ContextMenu>
  <ContextMenuTrigger>Right click this area</ContextMenuTrigger>
  <ContextMenuContent>
    <ContextMenuItem>Copy</ContextMenuItem>
  </ContextMenuContent>
</ContextMenu>
```

**Notes:**
- Installs the commands polyfill when rendered.
- Menu content is focus-trapped via `<dialog>`.

#### Sheet

Side or bottom sheet overlay with directional variants.

**Source:** `src/components/sheet/index.tsx`

**Exports:**

| Export | Renders As | k Attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Sheet` | `(composite)` | `—` |
| `SheetTrigger` | `(composite)` | `—` |
| `SheetContent` | `(composite)` | `—` |
| `SheetClose` | `(composite)` | `—` |

**Compound access:**
- `Sheet.Trigger` = `SheetTrigger`
- `Sheet.Content` = `SheetContent`
- `Sheet.Close` = `SheetClose`

**Props:**

*SheetOwnProps:*

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | — | Optional ID for the sheet dialog. If not provided, one will be auto-generated. |

*SheetContentOwnProps:*

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | — | Override the auto-generated dialog ID. |

**Usage:**

```tsx
import {Sheet, SheetClose, SheetContent, SheetTrigger} from 'kinu';

<Sheet>
  <SheetTrigger><Button>Open</Button></SheetTrigger>
  <SheetContent side="right">Panel</SheetContent>
  <SheetClose><Button>Close</Button></SheetClose>
</Sheet>
```

**Notes:**
- Control the slide direction with the side attribute on SheetContent.
- SheetClose attaches the close command to any child element.

#### Accordion

Disclosure built on the native `<details>` element with smooth open and close animation.

**Source:** `src/components/accordion/index.tsx`

**Exports:**

| Export | Renders As | k Attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Accordion` | `<details>` | `k="accordion"` |

**Props:**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | `boolean` | — | Controls the open state of the details element. |

*Also accepts all native `<details>` HTML attributes.*

**Usage:**

```tsx
import {Accordion} from 'kinu';

<Accordion open>
  <summary>Details</summary>
  <p>Hidden content</p>
</Accordion>
```

**Notes:**
- Forwards every native `<details>` attribute so you can control open state.
- Provide your own `<summary>` element to define the trigger.

#### Avatar

Styled `<img>` avatar that falls back to initials from the alt text.

**Source:** `src/components/avatar/index.tsx`

**Exports:**

| Export | Renders As | k Attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Avatar` | `(composite)` | `—` |

**Props:**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `src` | `string` | — | Image source for the avatar. |
| `alt` | `string` | — | Alt text used by the image and for fallback initials. |
| `children` | `element.children` | — | Fallback initials or text rendered via the alt attribute. |
| `size` | `AvatarSize` | — | Size preset for the avatar. |

**Usage:**

```tsx
import {Avatar} from 'kinu';

<Avatar alt="JM" src="/user.jpg" />
```

**Notes:**
- Uses the alt attribute content as a CSS-rendered fallback when the image fails.
- Override dimensions in CSS if you need sizes other than the 2rem default.

#### Tree

Composable tree view built from native `<details>` and `<summary>` primitives.

**Source:** `src/components/tree/index.tsx`

**Exports:**

| Export | Renders As | k Attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Tree` | `(composite)` | `—` |

**Usage:**

```tsx
import {Tree} from 'kinu';

<Tree>
  <Tree.Group open>
    <Tree.GroupLabel>src</Tree.GroupLabel>
    <Tree.GroupItems>
      <Tree.Item>index.ts</Tree.Item>
    </Tree.GroupItems>
  </Tree.Group>
</Tree>
```

**Notes:**
- State is native via the `open` attribute on `Tree.Group`.
- Nest `Tree.Group` inside `Tree.GroupItems` for deeper hierarchies.

#### Carousel

Scroll snapping carousel with previous/next helpers.

**Source:** `src/components/carousel/index.tsx`

**Exports:**

| Export | Renders As | k Attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Carousel` | `(composite)` | `—` |
| `CarouselContent` | `(composite)` | `—` |
| `CarouselItem` | `<div>` | `k="carousel-item"` |
| `CarouselPrevious` | `(composite)` | `—` |
| `CarouselNext` | `(composite)` | `—` |

**Props:**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | — | Optional ID for the carousel content. If not provided, one will be auto-generated. |

**Usage:**

```tsx
import {Carousel, CarouselContent, CarouselItem, CarouselNext, CarouselPrevious} from 'kinu';

<Carousel>
  <CarouselContent>
    <CarouselItem>Slide</CarouselItem>
  </CarouselContent>
  <CarouselPrevious />
  <CarouselNext />
</Carousel>
```

**Notes:**
- Leverages CSS scroll snap for buttery momentum.
- Content remains fully declarative.

#### Input

**Source:** `src/components/input/index.tsx`

**Exports:**

| Export | Renders As | k Attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | `<input>` | `k="input"` |

**Props:**

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `InputSize` | 'md' | Size preset for the input field. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | — | Marks the input as invalid for styling purposes. |
| `value` | `string | number | readonly string[] | undefined` | — | Input value. |
| `type` | `string | undefined` | — | Input type attribute. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | — | Placeholder text for the input. |
| `onInput` | `(event: InputEvent) => void` | — | Change handler for controlled inputs. |
| `onBlur` | `(event: FocusEvent) => void` | — | Blur handler. |
| `onFocus` | `(event: FocusEvent) => void` | — | Focus handler. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | — | Disables interactions and applies disabled styling. |
| `name` | `string` | — | Input name attribute used for form submissions. |

*Also accepts all native `<input>` HTML attributes.*

**Usage:**

```tsx
import {Input} from 'kinu';

<Input placeholder="Email" type="email" />
```

**Notes:**
- Wraps the native `<input>` element so forms behave as expected.
- Supports size="sm" and size="lg" for compact or spacious layouts.

*SidebarTriggerOwnProps:*

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `commandFor` | `string` | — | Target sidebar ID to control. |

*Also accepts all native `<button>` HTML attributes.*

*SidebarOwnProps:*

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | — | Optional ID for the sidebar dialog. |

*Also accepts all native `<dialog>` HTML attributes.*

**Usage:**

```tsx
import {Sidebar, SidebarTrigger} from 'kinu';

<Sidebar id="app-sidebar">
  <nav>...</nav>
</Sidebar>
<SidebarTrigger commandFor="app-sidebar">Toggle</SidebarTrigger>
```

**Notes:**
- Renders a `<dialog>` so it can slide in as a modal on small screens.
- SidebarTrigger toggles the hidden/open state with the command attribute.

### Navigation

#### Tabs

TabList, Tab, and TabPanel wrappers using aria attributes.

**Source:** `src/components/tabs/index.tsx`

**Exports:**

| Export | Renders As | k Attribute |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `TabList` | `<div>` | `k="tablist"` |
| `Tab` | `<button>` | `k="tab"` |
| `TabPanel` | `<div>` | `k="tab-panel"` |

**Props:**

*TabOwnProps:*

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aria-selected` | `boolean | "true" | "false"` | — | Marks the tab as selected. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | — | Disable tab interactions. |

*Also accepts all native `<button>` HTML attributes.*

*TabPanelOwnProps:*

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hidden` | `boolean` | — | Hide the panel when inactive. |

*Also accepts all native `<div>` HTML attributes.*

**Usage:**

```tsx
import {Tab, TabList, TabPanel} from 'kinu';

<TabList role="tablist">
  <Tab role="tab" aria-selected="true">Account</Tab>
  <Tab role="tab" aria-selected="false">Password</Tab>
</TabList>
<TabPanel role="tabpanel">Account settings</TabPanel>
```

**Notes:**
- Control selection state by toggling aria-selected.
- TabPanel toggles the hidden attribute so CSS handles transitions.

## Toast System

Imperative notification API — not a component with props, but an event-driven system.

```tsx
import { toast, ToastContainer } from 'kinu';

// Render once near app root:
<ToastContainer />

// Show toasts from anywhere:
toast.show('Settings saved');
toast.show('File uploaded', {
  title: 'Success',
  icon: '✅',
  action: <button onClick={undo}>Undo</button>,
  duration: 4000
});
```

### ToastOptions Interface

```typescript
interface ToastOptions {
  title?: ComponentChild;    // Title above toast body
  icon?: ComponentChild;     // Icon element
  action?: ComponentChild;   // Action button
  duration?: number;         // Auto-dismiss delay (default: 3000ms)
}

interface ToastApi {
  show(content: ComponentChild, options?: ToastOptions): void;
}
```

### Toast CSS Hooks

```css
[k="toast"] { }                 /* Base toast */
[k="toast"][data-mounted] { }    /* Entrance animation */
[k="toast"][data-closing] { }    /* Exit animation */
```

Max 3 toasts visible at once. Staggered entrance animations. DOM-event-driven (no prop drilling).

## CSS Selector Patterns

All components style via `[k="name"]` attribute selectors:

```css
/* Target a component */
[k="button"] { }

/* Variant */
[k="button"][variant="secondary"] { }
[k="badge"][variant="destructive"] { }

/* Size */
[k="button"][size="sm"] { }
[k="input"][size="lg"] { }

/* Boolean state */
[k="button"][loading] { opacity: 0.6; }
[k="button"][disabled] { }
[k="input"][invalid] { }

/* ARIA state */
[k="tab"][aria-selected="true"] { }
[k="toggle"][aria-pressed="true"] { }

/* Combined */
[k="button"][variant="destructive"][size="lg"] { }
```

## Accessibility Patterns

### Keyboard Navigation
- All interactive components support keyboard navigation
- Overlays (Dialog, Sheet, Drawer, DropdownMenu) trap focus and close on Escape
- TabList supports arrow-key navigation between tabs
- DropdownMenu/ContextMenu support arrow-key item navigation

### ARIA Best Practices
```tsx
// Always label form controls:
<Label htmlFor="email">Email</Label>
<Input id="email" type="email" required />

// Tabs need roles and aria-selected:
<TabList role="tablist">
  <Tab role="tab" aria-selected="true">Active</Tab>
</TabList>
<TabPanel role="tabpanel">Content</TabPanel>

// Toggle uses aria-pressed automatically:
<Toggle pressed={isBold}>Bold</Toggle>

// Spinners and loading states:
<Spinner aria-label="Loading" />
<Button loading disabled>Saving...</Button>

// Pagination current page:
<PaginationLink aria-current="page">1</PaginationLink>
```

## Integration Examples

### Login Form

```tsx
import { Button, Card, Input, Label, toast, ToastContainer } from 'kinu';

function LoginForm() {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');

  return (
    <>
      <form onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); toast.show("Logged in!"); }}>
        <Card>
          <Label htmlFor="email">Email</Label>
          <Input id="email" type="email" value={email} onInput={(e) => setEmail(e.currentTarget.value)} required />
          <Label htmlFor="pw">Password</Label>
          <Input id="pw" type="password" value={password} onInput={(e) => setPassword(e.currentTarget.value)} required />
          <Button type="submit">Sign In</Button>
        </Card>
      </form>
      <ToastContainer />
    </>
  );
}
```

### Dashboard with Sidebar

```tsx
import { Sidebar, SidebarTrigger, NavigationMenu, NavigationMenuList,
  NavigationMenuItem, NavigationMenuLink, Card, Progress, ToastContainer } from 'kinu';

function Dashboard() {
  return (
    <div style={{ display: "flex" }}>
      <Sidebar id="main-sidebar">
        <nav>
          <a href="/dashboard" aria-current="page">Dashboard</a>
          <a href="/users">Users</a>
          <a href="/settings">Settings</a>
        </nav>
      </Sidebar>
      <main>
        <SidebarTrigger commandFor="main-sidebar">☰</SidebarTrigger>
        <Card><Progress value={75} max={100} /></Card>
      </main>
      <ToastContainer />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Dialog with Form

```tsx
import { Dialog, Button, Input, Label } from 'kinu';

function EditDialog() {
  return (
    <Dialog>
      <Dialog.Trigger><Button>Edit Profile</Button></Dialog.Trigger>
      <Dialog.Content>
        <h3>Edit Profile</h3>
        <Label htmlFor="name">Name</Label>
        <Input id="name" placeholder="Your name" />
        <Dialog.Close><Button variant="outline">Cancel</Button></Dialog.Close>
        <Button type="submit">Save</Button>
      </Dialog.Content>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
```

### Dropdown with Actions

```tsx
import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuTrigger, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, Button } from 'kinu';

function ActionsMenu() {
  return (
    <DropdownMenu>
      <DropdownMenuTrigger><Button variant="outline">Actions</Button></DropdownMenuTrigger>
      <DropdownMenuContent>
        <DropdownMenuItem onClick={() => console.log("edit")}>Edit</DropdownMenuItem>
        <DropdownMenuItem shortcut="⌘D">Duplicate</DropdownMenuItem>
        <DropdownMenuItem destructive>Delete</DropdownMenuItem>
      </DropdownMenuContent>
    </DropdownMenu>
  );
}
```

### Data Table

```tsx
import { Table, Badge, Button, Card } from 'kinu';

function UsersTable({ users }) {
  return (
    <Card>
      <Table>
        <thead><tr><th>Name</th><th>Status</th><th>Actions</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          {users.map(u => (
            <tr key={u.id}>
              <td>{u.name}</td>
              <td><Badge variant={u.active ? undefined : "secondary"}>{u.active ? "Active" : "Inactive"}</Badge></td>
              <td><Button size="sm" variant="ghost">Edit</Button></td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </Table>
    </Card>
  );
}
```
